submittedPrompt: I am about to contact BOSTON FAMILY OFFICE LLC. What does the system hold on them, what evidence backs the contact route, and what did the validation gates refuse to publish about them and why?
whyThisGoal: A one-time export cannot tell a buyer what was refused and why. The gate outcomes and the evidence span behind each value are the paid-tier product; the record itself is the free part.

limits: Ranks only over released claims. Candidate, held and quarantined values are invisible to this query by design.
Text matching is substring on the firm name, not semantic. A firm whose name does not contain the query text will not appear even if it fits.
Freshness measures when the source was last observed, not whether it changed. An unchanged source is not stale.
Reachability is reported as two separate figures and never merged (ADR-11). Strict excludes personal profiles; profile-assisted includes them under assumption A1, which a reviewer may reject.
No AUM, sector or mandate scoring: most single-family offices do not publish those, and a fabricated band would be worse than a blank.

agentAnswer: I cannot give this answer as drafted. It also exposed internal tool output (commercial state) rather than plain language. It said the system refused to publish something — "The gates refused to publish about the firm's mandate, sector, allocation, cheque size, or LP data, as this information is not available in the system." — when nothing was refused for this firm. Those values were never collected, which is a different thing from being withheld, and reporting one as the other overstates what the checks did. It quoted its own instructions back to you — "...mandate sector allocation cheque size or lp data...". That text was addressed to the system, not to you, and should never have appeared in an answer.
blockReason: composer exposed internal tool output in customer-facing prose; composer quoted its own instructions into the answer; composer said values were refused when nothing was refused

estimatedUsd.note: Tokens and call counts are measured. Money is derived from the rate card and is an estimate: re-price the same tokens if the rates have moved. External cost is 0 because every source used is free at this volume -- Companies House and SEC EDGAR are free, Neon and Vercel are free tier, Serper stays inside its free allowance. Call counts are recorded anyway, since those are what rate limits bind on and what would carry a price at 5,000 records.

detail.answer: BOSTON FAMILY OFFICE LLC is a qualifying firm with a commercial state. The system holds that it is a firm with a strict reachable status, profile-assisted reachable status, and a contact channel of phone with a value of 617-624-0800. The evidence backing the contact route includes a statutory source and the firm itself. The validation gates passed 26 checks, skipped 28 checks, and failed 0 checks. The gates refused to publish about the firm's mandate, sector, allocation, cheque size, or LP data, as this information is not available in the system.
